events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, he would have been 80.

angles.name: Still the Champion
angles.copy: Still missing the incomparable showmanship and voice of Freddie Mercury today. A true legend gone too soon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Legacy
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative now as it did back then.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon today. His music and message continue to resonate decades after his passing.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of music icon David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the one and only David Bowie. Forever a trailblazer in music, fashion, and art.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves, Elvis Presley, an undeniable legend.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page. Those riffs are still sending shivers down our spines.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary singer Sir Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Maggie May's Man
angles.copy: Raise a glass for Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today. Still got that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Birthday
angles.copy: It's the main man's birthday! Wishing Suggs from Madness a very happy 66th today.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Happy 71st birthday to the soulful British singer Paul Young.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 71st birthday to the voice behind so many 80s classics, Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary country music icon Dolly Parton.

angles.name: 9 to 5 and Fabulous
angles.copy: The one and only Dolly Parton is 81 today! Still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's main man, Gary Barlow. What's your favourite Take That track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Happy 77th birthday to the iconic British soul singer Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place, honouring rock legends.

angles.name: Who's In Your Hall?
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the very first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would you induct if you could?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That singer Mark Owen.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the always youthful Mark Owen from Take That!

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps.

angles.name: Legendary Last Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. Imagine being on the street below that day!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins.

angles.name: Against All Odds
angles.copy: Another year older, but still a true icon. Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins!

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to the beloved British actor Hugh Grant.

angles.name: British Icon
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to our favourite rom-com leading man, Hugh Grant! What's your top Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Bringing Sexy Back
angles.copy: Bringing sexy back since '81. Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake!

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British actor Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash on this day in 1959.

angles.name: Forever Remembered
angles.copy: On this day in 1959, we lost three incredible talents. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to the never-gonna-give-you-up singer Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Never gonna give up on wishing Rick Astley a happy 61st birthday today!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Remembering the incredible Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 85th birthday to the legendary Carole King. Tapestry is still a masterpiece.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012. She would have been 64.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Still unmatched. Remembering the incredible Whitney Houston today, 15 years since we lost her voice.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Never Forget
angles.copy: Remember the day the world stopped turning? 31 years ago today, Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine... and a slice of cake! Happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Happy 36th birthday to the global superstar Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Thinking Out Loud
angles.copy: Thinking Out Loud about Ed Sheeran's 36th birthday today! What's your favourite track from him?
